decisions: The retained original stays uncropped and EXIF-normalized so later re-crops regenerate display and thumbnail derivatives from it.
Display and thumbnail receive the normalized crop and user rotation; the original is capped at 4096px by default or the decoded size when full-resolution is opted in.
Cancellation is honored through validation, decode, transform, and encoding, and is re-checked immediately before the repository transaction.
createCardWithAttachments already existed from DATA-2; CAP-1 reuses its single-transaction path and only adds contract documentation.
WebP encoding failures fall back to JPEG, and the stored MIME is always resolved from the encoder's actual Blob type.

payload.taskDescription: Build imageValidation.ts to check the 30 MB limit, JPEG/PNG/WebP magic bytes, MIME compatibility, and decodability. Build imagePipeline.ts to decode with EXIF orientation, apply a normalized crop and 0/90/180/270 rotation, produce a 4096px quality-0.9 original by default or the full imported resolution when opted in, a 2048px display derivative, and a 320px thumbnail, never upscaling. Extend CaseRepository with createCardWithAttachments so the card and three Blobs commit in one transaction. Add cardImport.ts to orchestrate validation, processing, and persistence with abort and cleanup. Do not add the crop UI or capture route.
